item_short_desc: Rothco’s Boatman’s Whistle is the ideal accessory for boating enthusiasts and sailors, combining timeless design with reliable functionality. Crafted with a traditional nautical appearance and a polished gold finish, this whistle brings an authentic maritime touch to your adventures. It features a long chain for convenient access, ensuring it's always within reach when needed. Perfect for signaling on the water or as a collector’s piece, this whistle is both stylish and practical.
description: Rothco’s Boatman’s Whistle is the ideal accessory for boating enthusiasts and sailors, combining timeless design with reliable functionality. It features a long chain for convenient access, ensuring it's always within reach when needed.
